title: Design LinkedIn Professional Network
description: Model profiles, connections, jobs, and professional feed.

data.text: Design LinkedIn. Users create profiles, connect with others, post updates, apply for jobs, and see a feed of connections' activity.

data.title: Profile, Connection, and JobPosting
Why bidirectional connections?
data.text: LinkedIn connections are mutual. Store one Connection record with sorted UserA/UserB to avoid duplicates. Always query with Min/Max to find either direction.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Profile is the professional identity entity
Connection is a mutual, undirected edge
JobPosting links to a company profile
data.takeaway: LinkedIn is a professional graph. Profiles are nodes, connections are edges, and the feed is a 1-hop broadcast.
